app.name: Medicine Reminder
error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
error.upgradeRequired: This version of the app is too old. Please update it to continue.
mode.title: How will you use this app?
mode.caregiver.title: I look after someone's medicines
mode.caregiver.body: Set up medicines and schedules, and get told if a dose is missed.
mode.patient.title: I take medicines
mode.patient.body: Get reminders on this phone. Your caregiver gives you a code.
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.register.title: Create your account
auth.register.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.consent.label: I agree to the privacy notice, and I may share this patient's details with this app.
auth.error.invalid: The email or password is wrong.
auth.error.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
auth.replaced.title: Signed in on another phone
auth.replaced.body: Your account is now signed in on a different phone, so this one was signed out.
auth.expired.body: You were signed out. Please sign in again.
notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.draft: Draft text. The final notice needs legal review before the app is released.
notice.body: This app stores the patient's name, medicines, notes, photos, schedule and answers, plus your phone's settings and push token. We use them only to remind the patient and to tell their caregiver when a dose is missed. You can export or delete your data in Settings.
patients.title: Patients
patients.empty: No patients yet. Add the first person you look after.
patients.subscriptionNeeded: An active subscription is needed to add patients.
patientNew.title: Add a patient
patientNew.name: Name
patientNew.error.name: Enter a name.
patient.connect.title: Connect their phone
patient.connect.body: Hand this code to {{name}} in person or in a trusted chat. Whoever enters it first becomes {{name}}.
patient.devices.title: Connected phones
patient.devices.confirm: Disconnect this phone? It stops getting reminders.
patient.archive.confirm: Archive {{name}}? Reminders stop and their phones are disconnected. History is kept.
pair.title: Connect to your caregiver
pair.consent.title: Before we connect
pair.consent.body: Your caregiver will see when you take your medicines, and gets an alert if you miss one.
pair.code.label: Code
pair.camera.denied: The camera is off. Type the code instead.
pair.error.invalid: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
pair.error.expired: That code has expired or was already used. Ask your caregiver for a new one.
pair.error.deviceLimit: This person already has the most phones allowed. Ask your caregiver to disconnect one.
pair.error.suspended: Reminders are paused for this person right now.
pair.error.notOurCode: That is not a Medicine Reminder code.
today.title: Today
today.paused: Reminders are paused. Ask your caregiver.
today.grace: Reminders stop tomorrow. Ask your caregiver.
rejected.title: Ask your caregiver for a new code
rejected.body: This phone is no longer connected. Reminders already on this phone still ring. Enter a new code to connect again.
upgrade.title: Please update the app
upgrade.body: This version is too old to sync. Reminders already on this phone keep working.
